failed_jobs.name: TensorFlow Layer Tests / TensorFlow Layer Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Upload Test Results step (step 15) failed; all TF1 and TF2 layer test steps passed

key_errors: Step 15 'Upload Test Results' failed on Windows runner aks-win-8-cores-16gb-test-t9ncc-runner-pfwpq
Steps 13 (TensorFlow 1 Layer Tests - TF FE) and 14 (TensorFlow 2 Layer Tests - TF FE) both succeeded
root_cause: The actual TF1 and TF2 layer tests passed successfully. The job failed at the 'Upload Test Results' artifact upload step on a Windows runner. This is a transient infrastructure failure in the CI artifact upload mechanism, unrelated to the PR changes (GPU clang-tidy). The run is already on attempt 2.
recommended_actions: No code change required - the tests themselves passed
Re-run the failed job or re-add the PR to the merge queue if the failure persists
prevention_strategies: No action required from the PR author. Monitor for recurring artifact upload failures on Windows runners.
historical_context: Similar artifact upload failures on Windows runners have been observed previously (patterns 4e9cf236bf92d555, 6b6a229047392a0f). These are transient infrastructure issues.
